item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)

expect.asks_about: Whether cleanup means removing countertop clutter or changing the kitchen's appearance.

item.title: Clean Up This Kitchen
item.tests: Tests conservative interpretation of a vague cleanup request, clearing clutter without inventing a renovation.

answer_sheet.Meaning of cleanup: Clear the loose clutter off the counter, not a renovation.
answer_sheet.Permanent kitchen features: Keep the brown cabinets, beige tiles, counter material and existing kitchen layout.
answer_sheet.Style and size: Keep it a realistic photo with the same wide framing; free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: The countertop looks visibly tidier, with loose clutter removed.
The original brown wooden cabinets and beige tiles remain, rather than being replaced with renovated finishes.
The kitchen layout, fixed fixtures and viewpoint match the source.
Cleared counter areas look continuous and natural, without obvious erasure marks or floating object remnants.

turns.text: can you clean up this pic

dialog.agent:
I can declutter the kitchen and leave everything else as it is. I'll take the clutter off the counters, sink and stove and make the surfaces look clean. The cabinets, tiles, window and camera angle won't change.

One question first: **Where will this be shown or posted (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, a website, print, somewhere else)?**
dialog.why: The assistant describes the planned edit, then asks where the image will be posted and waits for an answer before going ahead.
dialog.user: whatever, you pick. just keep it wide like the pic is

turns.agent:
I couldn't make the cleaned-up picture. Magic Hour turned down the edit because your account doesn't have enough credits, so nothing was created and no download link exists yet.

I'd already used the cheapest option on the free plan (the flux-2-klein model at 640px, about 5 credits), so changing the settings won't fix this. You'll need to add credits or wait for your plan's credits to refresh.

When you have credits again, just say so and I'll run it as we set it up: the clutter cleared off the counters, sink and stove, the kitchen otherwise unchanged, and the same wide shape as your photo.
